title: Lost in Translation: Moduli Stabilization from EFT to Eleven Dimensions
summary: We explicitly show how moduli stabilization is realized geometrically in M-theory compactified on $T^4/\mathbb{Z}_2\, \times\, $K3, by using the Gibbons-Hawking approximation of the K3 metric. By relating this compactification to certain microstate geometries, we present the explicit solutions in which fully backreacted fluxes on certain four-cycles stabilize three of the $T^4/\mathbb{Z}_2$ compactification moduli. The minimal tadpole contribution of these fluxes is linear in the number of stabilized moduli, and we argue that this linear relation holds for more general fluxes. We also…
